description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 画笔、荧光笔在图上点一下就留一个圆点，不用拖（#461）；截图和编辑图片时，鼠标指针显示成笔尖的大小和颜色。标注工具栏最前面多了“选择”按钮（箭头），点它放下正在用的工具，回到选择和移动。权限不变。
notes.en: A click with the pen or the highlighter leaves a dot (#461), and while capturing or editing a picture the pointer shows the brush tip's size and colour. A Select button (an arrow) first on the annotation toolbar puts the current tool down. Permissions unchanged.
